newsitem.title: CHINA: China venture expands production of ammonia, urea.
newsitem.headline: China venture expands production of ammonia, urea.

text.p: A venture in China's northwestern Xinjiang region has launched a new production line that will supply an annual 300,000 tonnes of synthetic ammonia and 520,000 tonnes of urea, an official newspaper said on Monday.

Production began at the line in the Urumqi Petrochemical General Plant on Saturday, with daily output of ammonia at 1,000 tonnes and of urea at 1,760 tonnes, the Overseas edition of the People's Daily said.

State-owned refiner China Petrochemical Corp (Sinopec) and the Xinjiang regional government had jointly invested 1.96 billion yuan ($236 million) in the production line, the second at the Urumqi plant, the newspaper said.
The new line brought total annual production of synthetic ammonia from the plant to 600,000 tonnes, while output of urea would reach 1.04 million tonnes, it said.
Xinjiang was now China's biggest nitrogen fertiliser production base, the newspaper said but gave no other details.
